messages.text: Hello Eva, this is Marco Rossi, purchasing manager at Rossi Telecom SRL in Milan. We distribute mobile accessories to 42 retail stores in Italy. Website: https://www.rossitelecom.it, VAT IT1029384756. We found your S25 Ultra magnetic rugged case on Accio. Are you the manufacturer?
Hello Marco, nice to meet you. Yes, we are a Shenzhen manufacturer for phone cases, screen protectors, chargers and power banks. The S25 Ultra magnetic rugged case is our current stock model.
We want a trial order for 500 pcs, clear back + black frame. It must support magnetic charging, have raised camera protection, and fit S25 Ultra exactly. What is your MOQ, stock and lead time?

The case is TPU + PC, with N52 magnets, air-cushion corners, 1.5 mm raised camera lip, and wireless charging support. MOQ is 100 pcs. Current stock: 1,200 pcs clear back + black frame. Stock order can ship within 3-5 business days after payment.
Please quote 500 pcs and 1,000 pcs. Also confirm packing options, CE/RoHS documents, and whether you can add our barcode and logo.

For 500 pcs: US$2.85/pc EXW Shenzhen. For 1,000 pcs: US$2.70/pc EXW. Neutral OPP bag is included. Retail box is +US$0.18/pc. Logo/EAN sticker is +US$0.08/pc, MOQ 500 pcs. CE and RoHS reports are available.
What are carton quantity, carton size and gross weight? We need these for our import estimate.
Carton details: 100 pcs/carton, 13.8 kg gross weight, carton size 56 x 38 x 42 cm. For 500 pcs it will be 5 cartons, around 69 kg gross weight.
Can we get samples first? We need to check magnet strength, side buttons and retail box quality before confirming the 500 pcs order.

Yes. Sample cost is US$35 including DHL to Milan. We can send 2 pcs clear/black, 1 pc clear/blue, a retail box mockup and a blank EAN sticker. Sample can ship tomorrow and usually arrives in 4-5 days.
Our target for the trial order is US$2.60/pc because the local retail price will be under EUR 8.99. Can you meet this for 500 pcs?
For 500 pcs we cannot reach US$2.60. The best trial price is US$2.78/pc EXW. For the next 1,000 pcs order we can offer US$2.68/pc EXW if the packaging artwork stays the same.
Please quote DDP air shipping to our Milan warehouse for 500 pcs with retail box, logo/EAN sticker, and Italian warranty card.

For 500 pcs DDP Milan: case US$2.78 + retail box US$0.18 + logo/EAN sticker US$0.08 + Italian warranty card US$0.04 = US$3.08/pc. Goods total US$1,540. Air DDP freight is US$420. Total DDP Milan is US$1,960.
What is the delivery schedule if we approve the sample and pay the deposit on June 24?
If deposit and artwork are confirmed before 15:00 Beijing time on June 24, production starts June 25, finishes July 1, shipment leaves Shenzhen July 2, and estimated Milan delivery is July 7-9.
Please send product video, magnet test, CE/RoHS reports and the artwork template for the retail box.

Sent. Files: product_video_S25U_magnetic_case.mp4, magnet_test_1kg.mp4, CE-2026-0429.pdf, RoHS-RSH2026-0518.pdf, and retail_box_artwork_template.ai. Please send your logo, EAN numbers and Italian warranty card text.
Can you confirm warranty policy? Our retailers require at least 12 months and replacement support for defective units.

Warranty is 12 months for material and workmanship defects. If defective rate is below 1%, replacements are included in the next order. If defect is confirmed from production issue, we replace or credit the defective quantity.
Payment terms?
For bulk order: 30% deposit and 70% balance before shipment. Payment can be T/T or Alibaba Trade Assurance. For sample, PayPal is OK.
Can you make the bulk DDP total US$1,900 if the sample is approved? This will help us keep the launch price.
We can reduce US$35 from product/freight and offer final DDP Milan total US$1,925 for 500 pcs. For the next order of 1,000 pcs, estimated DDP unit price can be around US$2.95 if freight is similar.
OK, let us proceed with sample first. Please issue sample PI to marco.rossi@rossitelecom.it. Delivery address: Rossi Telecom SRL, Via Torino 18, 20123 Milan, Italy. WhatsApp: +39 347 555 0198.
Sample PI sent: ST-2026-0622-IT01. Sample package includes 2 pcs clear/black, 1 pc clear/blue, retail box mockup and blank EAN sticker. Total sample invoice: US$35 including DHL.
Payment sent via PayPal. Transaction ID PP-984521. Please ship tomorrow and send tracking once available.
Payment received, thank you. Sample will ship on June 23 by DHL. I will send tracking before 18:00 Beijing time tomorrow.
DHL tracking number: 1234567890. Estimated delivery to Milan: June 27. I also uploaded QC photos of the sample package.
Thanks. If the sample is approved on June 27 or June 28, we plan to pay the 30% deposit next Monday. Please prepare the final 500 pcs quote and artwork checklist.

Noted. Follow-up items: wait for sample feedback June 27-28; prepare final 500 pcs DDP Milan quote at US$1,925; collect logo file, EAN numbers and Italian warranty card text; then issue bulk PI with 30% deposit US$577.50.
